"Welcome to the Physio Medica Clinic Team (PMC Team) 🌿 This group is dedicated to physiotherapy professionals, students and enthusiasts who want to learn, share knowledge, and grow together. We will be organizing webinars, seminars, and workshops on physiotherapy and holistic health. Let’s collaborate, inspire, and make a difference!"

YouTube Channel:
https://youtube.com/@physiomedicahub?si=wHD1jkEDy3Du06qh
